summary: Iteration 6 verified the revised RBAC access model (anonymous add allowed; editor edit-only-payment; approver full). Backend: 130/130 pytest pass across 5 files after updating anon/editor tests. Frontend Playwright verified anonymous, editor '16', and approver '158' flows end-to-end. New/updated backend tests: anon POST returns 201 with payment_mode='', payment_by='', business_manager_approved=False even when the request tries to sneak them in; anon POST with only 3 basic fields also 201; anon PATCH single/bulk approval 401; anon PUT/DELETE 401; anon upload-bill/import 401. Editor create with approved=true now returns 201 (forced false); editor PUT applies only payment_mode/payment_by while employee_id/name/purchase_type/business_manager_approved/purchase_date are preserved; editor PUT with an invalid payment_mode returns 422; editor PUT trying to flip approval returns 200 but approval stays False; editor DELETE now 403; single/bulk PATCH approval 403 for editor. Approver positive path (create-approved, single/bulk approval, flip via PUT, delete) all 200/201. CSV import RBAC unchanged: editor forces approved=false, approver honors Yes. Frontend: ANON header shows Add Purchase + Login (no Import); Add form shows only Employee ID/Name/Purchase Of, no payment/approval/date/bill; submit created a record showing '—' for Mode/Payment By, 'Not Approved', 'Login to edit'. EDITOR '16': import visible, no delete/select-all/inline-approve on rows; edit form has Employee ID/Name disabled, Payment Mode + Payment By enabled, no approval/date/bill. APPROVER '158': select-all, per-row delete + inline approve toggle, bulk action bar with Approve selected; form shows approval checkbox, manual date, bill upload, employee fields enabled. Toggled inline approval succeeded; bulk-approve bar rendered; cleanup deletes succeeded.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py update_purchase: editor branch validates payment_mode/payment_by individually inline instead of reusing _validate_enums; consider extracting a small helper to keep validation logic DRY.

PurchaseUpdate/PurchaseCreate still expect the full PurchaseBase shape (employee_id/employee_name/purchase_type required). Anonymous callers who forget purchase_type will get 422 — this is enforced but the anonymous-only frontend uses Select so it is fine. Consider a dedicated AnonymousPurchaseCreate model that only accepts basics to make the API self-documenting.

create_purchase: an anonymous caller who sends business_manager_approved=true silently gets it overridden to false with no warning. Consider returning a 200/201 with a warning field, or an explicit 422 when unauthenticated callers submit privileged fields, so scripts can detect misuse.
APPROVERS set is still derived from AUTH_USERNAME + AUTH_USERNAME_2 slots. Reordering .env silently reclassifies users; prefer an explicit APPROVER_USERNAMES env var.
server.py file is ~720 lines (auth, storage, routes, models, startup, import). Consider splitting into modules (auth.py, storage.py, routes/purchases.py, csv_import.py).

CSV import silently downgrades editor's Approved=Yes rows to false; response does not communicate how many rows were downgraded. Consider adding 'downgraded_approved_rows' to the import response for transparency.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Access model: anonymous can POST /api/purchases with basics (payment/approval ignored, date auto), no PUT/DELETE/PATCH/import/upload. Editors: full POST (approval forced false), PUT only touches payment_mode/payment_by (basics + approval + date preserved), no delete, no PATCH approval, no bulk approve. Approvers (158, 'IT admin'): full CRUD, single+bulk PATCH approval. Status conventions: missing token=401, wrong role=403, invalid payload=422. Backend tests are split across 5 files; run: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v. Note: xdist parallel run seeds and deletes TEST_* rows continuously; if debugging cleanup, run with -p no:xdist.
